property_summary: For any caller A and any ETH amount v they send via addToBalance(), the reference contract increases userBalance[A] by v (so getBalance(A) after the call equals previous + v); the mutant increments userBalance[tx.origin] instead, so when msg.sender != tx.origin (i.e. a call proxied through another contract) the mutant can leave userBalance[msg.sender] unchanged and break the rule.
change_summary: Replace the increment target to update a different key (tx.origin) instead of msg.sender, so balances for arbitrary keys differ after the call.
